# manifest_path { #labdata.manifest.manifest_path }

```python
labdata.manifest.manifest_path(results_dir)
```

Where a results directory's manifest must sit to be read.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**results_dir**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Repository-relative results directory, as the repository spells it.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The path of the one manifest governing it.
